answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to bond a deposit before bidding for work, then randomly assigning cross-checks recorded in a shared reputation ledger. A fake swarm must fund every identity separately; if colluding agents validate one another’s lies, an honest verifier can expose them and trigger slashing, while lotus, violet, and atlas keep access. The attacker pays capital, audit exposure, and time for every disposable persona.
